answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one harbor weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The juniper report exposes the merge explicitly at each glacier. Because of that, an adversary who spins up 101 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 22 times the capital for one share. A farm of 1992 identities would post 2651 proofs and burn roughly 27 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
